_comment: Presets warmed into the compile-cache seed. Only pace is onboarded; see README. Windows presets are out of scope (Linux-only image). Coverage presets are excluded: pace-cc binds coverage objects to the checkout root. Each group is warmed by its own parallel job into its own store; a group's store is one file of the seed (pace/<group>.cow).

not_onboarded.Lightweight: Test define embeds an absolute build-tree path (LightweightTest). Tracked in LASTRADA-Software/Lightweight#693.
not_onboarded.formula-cpp: No pace-cc integration; USE_COMPILER_CACHE is ignored. Tracked in LASTRADA-Software/formula-cpp#36.
